rule: sfx-design: one sound per moving thing, loudest on the fastest frame, at most one every 1.5 s, no variant twice in a row, ~12 dB under the voice (speech median -23 dBFS RMS -> effect peak -35). Effects only.

events.motion: zoom-through the 0 (fastest at the end of an ease-in)
